shell.tagline: Make every mama dey safe and well.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in make you continue.
login.wrong: Phone number, email or password no correct.
login.help: Your clinic go register you and send email give you make you set your password.

invite.expiredBody: Invite link dey work one time and e dey last 7 days. Ask Aboyun team make dem send new one, or sign in if you don already set your password.
invite.invalid: This link no work or e don expire. Ask Aboyun team for new one.
invite.failed: We no fit set your password. Abeg try again.

Errors.identifierRequired: Enter your phone number or email
Errors.identifierInvalid: Enter correct Nigerian phone number or email

Email.inviteSubject: Dem don invite you to Aboyun
Email.inviteIntro: Dem don register you for Aboyun. Use the link below set your password and sign in.
Email.resetIntro: Use the link below choose new password.
Email.footer: This link dey work one time and e go expire after 7 days.

header.waiting: {count, plural, one {# thing dey wait make e go} other {# things dey wait make dem go}}

badge.device: Dem save am for this phone

home.weeks: {weeks, plural, one {# week belle} other {# weeks belle}}
home.needsConnection: Use network one time make we load your details. After that, the app go work even if network no dey.
home.noVisit: Dem never book any visit for you. Your clinic go tell you.
home.passed: The visit date don pass. Abeg go your clinic.
home.emergencyHint: Press am if you or your pikin need help now now
home.checkHint: Answer small yes or no questions

LOW.title: You dey do well
LOW.body: Continue to go your clinic visits and take your tablet.

MEDIUM.title: Your clinic dey watch you well well
MEDIUM.body: Abeg no miss your next visit.

HIGH.title: Your clinic wan see you soon
HIGH.body: Abeg call your clinic, or go your next visit.

tablet.title: Your tablet for today
tablet.prompt: You don take your tablet today?
tablet.button: I don take my tablet today
tablet.done: Well done! You don take your tablet today.

check.title: Check your body
check.intro: Think how your body dey now. Answer yes or no.

signs.bleeding: Blood dey comot from your private part?
signs.headache: Your head dey pain you bad bad?
signs.fits: You don get fit or shake wey you no fit control?
signs.movement: Your belle pikin no dey move like before?
signs.fever: Your body dey hot or you get fever?
signs.swelling: Your face or your hand don swell?
signs.pain: Your belle dey pain you bad bad?

OK.title: No danger sign
OK.body: You no get any danger sign now. Continue to go your visits. Check again if your body change.

CLINIC_SOON.title: Abeg go your clinic soon
CLINIC_SOON.body: One of your answer need nurse to look am. Abeg go your clinic today or tomorrow.

GO_NOW.title: Abeg go clinic now now
GO_NOW.body: Go your clinic or the nearest health centre now. Ask person make una go together. If you no fit go, press the emergency button.

emergency.title: Wetin happen?
emergency.intro: Choose the one wey close pass. Dem go tell your clinic and your family.
emergency.sentBody: Stay where you dey if e safe. Dem dey arrange help.
emergency.queuedBody: Dem save am for this phone. E go go as network show. Call or text your clinic now.
emergency.smsBody: EMERGENCY. Na me {name}. {kind}. Abeg help me.

install.hint: Put Aboyun for your phone make e open like other app, even if data no dey.
install.ios: To install: press the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.

session.expiredBody: You no use network for more than 7 days. Sign in again make your records safe.

offline.title: No network
offline.body: This page no dey your phone yet. Use network and try again.
